product_overview: Qanoon ERP is an Arabic, offline-capable legal office management system that unifies financial collection, litigation, consultations, archival search, administration, and reporting into one workflow. It uses session-cookie authentication and server-side business rules to enforce permissions, workflow gates, and auditability.
core_goals: Provide a unified Arabic ERP for law firms and legal consultancies
Secure access through session-based authentication and role/permission controls
Support end-to-end legal workflows across financial files, cases, enforcement, and consultations
Preserve complete activity history, searchable archives, and document traceability
Enable operational reporting, Excel export, notifications, and backup visibility

features.name: Authentication and Session Management
features.description: Users log in with seeded credentials, receive a session cookie, and must reuse that cookie for all subsequent API calls. The system supports logout, profile/session inspection, and password changes with strict policy enforcement.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid username and password -> Receive 200 with user, permissions, settings and JSESSIONID cookie -> GET /api/auth/me with session cookie -> Receive 200 with current user, permissions, settings -> POST /api/auth/logout with session cookie -> Receive 200 with confirmation
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with Arabic error JSON and no redirect
POST /api/auth/change-password with oldPassword and a new password that violates policy -> Receive 400 with Arabic error JSON
GET /api/auth/me without a session cookie -> Receive 401 Not logged in

features.name: Dashboard and Lookups
features.description: Authenticated users can retrieve workload and financial dashboard widgets plus lookup data for dropdowns and reference selections.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with workload and financial totals -> GET /api/dashboard/urgent with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with urgent hearings, appeal deadlines, and installments -> GET /api/lookups with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with enum options and reference lists
GET /api/dashboard without a session cookie -> Receive 401 with Arabic error JSON
GET /api/lookups without authentication -> Receive 401 with Arabic error JSON

features.name: Legal Cases and Transfer Gate
features.description: Users can list, inspect, create, and transfer legal cases. Transfer to enforcement is protected by a server-side gate that rechecks all conditions on every attempt and blocks duplicate transfers.
user_flows: GET /api/cases with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with paged case list -> GET /api/cases/{id} for a case ID -> Receive 200 with case detail, hearings, appeals, attachments, and transfer check -> GET /api/cases/{id}/transfer-check -> Receive 200 with allowed status and blocking checks -> POST /api/cases/{id}/transfer when gate conditions are satisfied -> Receive 200 with execution number
GET /api/cases?status=unknown with valid session cookie -> Receive 400 Unknown status value
POST /api/cases/{id}/transfer for a case that does not satisfy the gate -> Receive 400 with Arabic blocking reasons
POST /api/cases/{id}/transfer twice for the same case -> Receive 400 Gate not satisfied or already transferred
GET /api/cases/{id} for a missing case ID -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Enforcement Files
features.description: Transferred cases become enforcement files where users can add execution orders, record payments, check satisfaction eligibility, and close satisfied files only when no balance remains.
user_flows: GET /api/executions with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with paged enforcement file list -> POST /api/executions/{id}/orders with orderType, orderNumber, and issuedDate -> Receive 200 with created order data -> POST /api/executions/{id}/payments with a valid case-sensitive payment method -> Receive 200 with recorded payment -> GET /api/executions/{id}/satisfaction-check -> Receive 200 with allowed status -> POST /api/executions/{id}/satisfy after balance reaches zero -> Receive 200 with satisfaction result
POST /api/executions/{id}/orders without orderType -> Receive 400 Missing or unknown orderType
POST /api/executions/{id}/payments with lowercase method such as cash -> Receive 400 Missing or unknown method
POST /api/executions/{id}/satisfy while a balance remains -> Receive 400 Balance remaining
GET /api/executions?status=unknown with valid session cookie -> Receive 400 Unknown status value

features.name: Legal Consultations
features.description: Users can create consultations, save opinions, review opinions, and retrieve ranked assignment suggestions. The system prevents self-review and locks signed opinions against further edits.
user_flows: POST /api/consultations with clientId, subject, requestText, and optional priority -> Receive 200 with created consultation data -> GET /api/consultations/suggest with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with ranked candidate list and reasons -> POST /api/consultations/{id}/opinion -> Receive 200 with confirmation -> POST /api/consultations/{id}/review by a different reviewer -> Receive 200 with confirmation
POST /api/consultations with invalid or unknown priority -> Receive 400 Validation error or unknown priority
POST /api/consultations/{id}/opinion after the consultation is signed -> Receive 400 Locked after signing
POST /api/consultations/{id}/review by the same author who wrote the opinion -> Receive 403 Author reviewing own opinion
GET /api/consultations?status=unknown with valid session cookie -> Receive 400 Unknown status

features.name: Financial Files and Payments
features.description: Financial collection files support payment logging, communication logging, and closure by a defined closure type. Payments are recorded pending first and then confirmed through a separate action.
user_flows: GET /api/financial with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with paged financial file list -> POST /api/financial/{id}/payments with amount, paymentDate, and method -> Receive 200 with pending payment data -> POST /api/payments/{id}/confirm -> Receive 200 with confirmed payment data -> POST /api/financial/{id}/close with a valid closureType -> Receive 200 with closure result
POST /api/financial/{id}/payments with lowercase method such as cash -> Receive 400 Missing or unknown method
POST /api/financial/{id}/communications without type or summary -> Receive 400 Missing type or summary
POST /api/financial/{id}/close with missing or unknown closureType -> Receive 400 Missing or unknown closureType
GET /api/financial?status=unknown with valid session cookie -> Receive 400 Unknown status

features.name: Parties Directory
features.description: Users can manage clients and debtors, filter them by type, and deactivate records while preserving referential history.
user_flows: GET /api/parties with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with parties sorted by name -> POST /api/parties with name and kind as a user with CLIENTS_MANAGE -> Receive 200 with created party data -> DELETE /api/parties/{id} -> Receive 200 with deactivation message
POST /api/parties without CLIENTS_MANAGE -> Receive 403 Lacks CLIENTS_MANAGE
POST /api/parties with missing name or kind -> Receive 400 Missing name or kind
GET /api/parties?kind=unknown with valid session cookie -> Receive 400 Unknown kind
DELETE /api/parties/{id} for a missing party -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Users, Roles and Settings
features.description: Administrators manage users, roles, permissions, and office settings through permission-gated APIs. System roles are protected from edit/delete, and role deletion is blocked when users still depend on the role.
user_flows: GET /api/users as a user with USERS_MANAGE -> Receive 200 with user list without password hashes -> POST /api/users with username, fullName, roleId, and compliant password -> Receive 200 with created user data -> GET /api/roles/permissions -> Receive 200 with permission codes and Arabic labels -> POST /api/roles with role code, name, and permissions -> Receive 200 with created role data -> GET /api/settings as a user with SETTINGS_MANAGE -> Receive 200 with system settings -> PUT /api/settings with a flat key/value map -> Receive 200 with save confirmation
GET /api/users without USERS_MANAGE -> Receive 403 Lacks USERS_MANAGE
GET /api/settings without SETTINGS_MANAGE -> Receive 403 Lacks SETTINGS_MANAGE
POST /api/users with duplicate username or unknown roleId -> Receive 400 Validation error or 404 Unknown roleId
POST /api/roles with only unknown permission codes -> Receive 400 Missing code/name or no valid permission
DELETE /api/roles/{id} for a system role or in-use role -> Receive 400 System role or role in use

features.name: Reports, Audit, Archive and Notifications
features.description: Users with the right permissions can generate reports, export them to Excel, inspect the audit log, search the archive, and manage in-app notifications and backups.
user_flows: GET /api/reports/financial with REPORTS_VIEW -> Receive 200 with report title, headers, rows, chart, and totals -> GET /api/reports/financial/export -> Receive 200 with binary xlsx output -> GET /api/audit with AUDIT_VIEW -> Receive 200 with paged audit entries -> GET /api/archive with valid session cookie -> Receive 200 with paged archive results -> GET /api/notifications/count -> Receive 200 with unread count -> POST /api/notifications/{id}/read -> Receive 200 with confirmation
GET /api/reports/unknown with REPORTS_VIEW -> Receive 400 Unknown report kind
GET /api/reports/financial without REPORTS_VIEW -> Receive 403 Lacks REPORTS_VIEW
GET /api/audit without AUDIT_VIEW -> Receive 403 Lacks AUDIT_VIEW
GET /api/archive?type=unknown with valid session cookie -> Receive 400 Unknown type
GET /api/backup without BACKUP_RUN -> Receive 403 Lacks BACKUP_RUN

tech_stack: H2 (dev profile, file-backed) / SQL Server (mssql profile)
Vanilla JS single-page frontend served from /static

features.name: Authentication and Session Management
features.description: Session-cookie authentication. Clients MUST POST /api/auth/login first and reuse the returned JSESSIONID cookie on every subsequent request. There is no JWT and no Authorization header. Seeded credentials - admin/Qanoon@123 (full permissions), lawyer1, lawyer2, consult1, consult2, senior1, secretary1 all with password Qanoon@123. All rejections return JSON {"error":"<arabic>","blockers":[]} and never redirect to a login page. Unauthenticated API access returns 401, missing permission returns 403.

endpoints.description: Log in and receive a session cookie. Wrong password returns 4xx.
Current user, permission codes, and office settings.
Invalidate the session. Subsequent calls with the cookie return 401.
Change own password. Enforces min 8 chars, one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit, one special character, no spaces, and must differ from the current password.

response_schema.400: Policy violation or wrong current password

features.name: Dashboard and Lookups
features.description: Aggregate workload/financial widgets and dropdown reference data.

endpoints.description: Workload array and financial totals for the current user.
Urgent items (hearings, appeal deadlines, installments).
All enum options as {value,label} plus lawyers, consultants, clients, debtors.

features.name: Legal Cases and Transfer Gate
features.description: Case lifecycle plus the six-condition gate that governs transferring a case to enforcement. The gate is re-evaluated server-side on every transfer attempt and the server never trusts the client. Transferring twice must fail with 400.

endpoints.description: Paged case list. Optional status filter is case-insensitive; an unknown status returns 400. Returns { items, total, page, size }.
Case detail with hearings, appeals, attachments and transfer check.
Create a case with an auto-generated case number.
Returns { allowed, checks[] } listing every blocking condition in Arabic.
Transfer to enforcement. Rejected with 400 when the gate is not satisfied.

response_schema.400: Gate not satisfied or already transferred

features.name: Enforcement Files
features.description: Enforcement files created from transferred cases, execution orders, payments, and the satisfaction gate. A file may not be satisfied while a remaining balance is greater than zero.

endpoints.description: Paged enforcement file list; status filter is case-insensitive.
Add an execution order. orderType is REQUIRED and matched case-sensitively against BANK_SEIZURE, TRAVEL_BAN, ARREST, PROPERTY_SEIZURE, SALARY_SEIZURE.
Record a payment. method is REQUIRED and case-sensitive - CASH, CHEQUE, CARD, TRANSFER.
Returns { allowed, ... }; false while a balance remains.
Close as satisfied. 400 while any balance remains.

features.name: Legal Consultations
features.description: Consultation lifecycle RECEIVED, STUDYING, UNDER_REVIEW, RETURNED, APPROVED, SIGNED, SENT, ARCHIVED. Two binding rules - an author may never review their own opinion, and a signed opinion is locked against edits even for a manager; corrections require a new consultation via the correction endpoint.

endpoints.description: Paged list; status filter case-insensitive, unknown value returns 400.
Create a consultation. priority is optional and defaults to NORMAL, but when sent it is case-sensitive - LOW, NORMAL, HIGH, URGENT.
Save opinion text. Returns 400 if the consultation is signed and locked.
Review an opinion. The opinion author must be rejected with 4xx.
Ranked assignment candidates, scores descending, each with a text reason.

features.name: Financial Files and Payments
features.description: Debt collection files, communications, installment plans, payments, and the five closure types. Payments are created pending and must be confirmed separately.

endpoints.description: Paged list; status filter case-insensitive, unknown value returns 400.
Record a payment. method is REQUIRED and case-sensitive - CASH, CHEQUE, CARD, TRANSFER. Lowercase such as cash must be rejected with 400.
Log a communication. type is REQUIRED and case-sensitive; summary is required.
Close the file. closureType is REQUIRED and case-sensitive - FULL_PAYMENT, INSTALLMENT, LEGAL_OPINION, EXEMPTION, ESCALATION.
Confirm a pending payment, updating the collected total.

features.name: Parties Directory
features.description: Clients and debtors. Deletion never removes a row; it deactivates the party to preserve referential history.

endpoints.description: List parties sorted by name. Optional kind filter accepts CLIENT or DEBTOR case-insensitively; an unknown kind returns 400.
Create a party. name and kind are both required. Requires CLIENTS_MANAGE.
Deactivate rather than delete; the record remains retrievable.

features.name: Users, Roles and Settings
features.description: Administration screens gated on USERS_MANAGE and SETTINGS_MANAGE. System roles cannot be edited or deleted, and a role still linked to users cannot be deleted.

endpoints.description: List users. Response must never contain a password hash.
Create a user. username, fullName, roleId and a policy-compliant password are required; a duplicate username is rejected and an unknown roleId returns 404.
All permission codes with Arabic labels.
Create a role. Unknown permission codes are silently filtered out; a role whose permissions are all unknown is rejected with 400.

response_schema.400: Missing code/name or no valid permission

endpoints.description: Delete a custom role. System roles and roles in use return 400.

response_schema.400: System role or role in use

endpoints.description: Office settings. Requires SETTINGS_MANAGE.
Save settings from a flat key/value map.

features.name: Reports, Audit, Archive and Notifications
features.description: Reporting with xlsx export, the activity log, the searchable archive, law codes, and per-user notifications.

endpoints.description: Build a report. kind is one of financial, cases, consultants, team; any other value returns 400. Requires REPORTS_VIEW. Every row must match the header column count.
Export the report as xlsx; the body starts with the PK zip signature.
Paged activity log with username/action/date filters. Requires AUDIT_VIEW.
Paged archive search. Optional type filter is case-insensitive; an unknown type returns 400.
Unread notification count for the current user.
Mark one notification read. Scoped to the current user, so an unknown id returns 200 rather than 404 by design, to avoid leaking other users' notification ids.
List backups. Requires BACKUP_RUN.

known_limitations.issue: Account lockout after 5 failed logins locks the account for 15 minutes. Tests that probe invalid credentials against a seeded account will lock it and cause later tests using the same account to fail.
known_limitations.impact: Negative-path login tests must use a throwaway account, never admin or another account reused by other tests.

known_limitations.issue: Only 2 concurrent sessions are allowed per user; a third login silently expires the oldest session.
known_limitations.impact: Tests that log in repeatedly as the same user can have earlier sessions invalidated mid-run, producing confusing 401s.

known_limitations.issue: Enum handling is deliberately asymmetric - read filters accept any letter case while state-changing write paths require the exact uppercase code.
known_limitations.impact: A payload of "cash" is correctly rejected with 400 on payment endpoints while ?status=open is correctly accepted on list endpoints. Both behaviours are intended and should not be reported as defects.

known_limitations.issue: All API responses and error messages are Arabic.
known_limitations.impact: Assertions must target HTTP status codes and JSON structure rather than English message text.

known_limitations.issue: The dev profile uses a file-backed H2 database, so tests that create, close or transfer records mutate persistent state shared across runs.
known_limitations.impact: Repeated runs are not idempotent; a case transferred in one run cannot be transferred again in the next.
